critical_failures.rationale: est_tausq=True silently ignored: tausq stayed at 0.0 (oracle estimates >1e-09) AND bump PIPs match the est_tausq=False regime (max error 0.1326 > tolerance 0.05). Two known failure modes produce this signature: (A) dead code where _mom_update is called with est_tausq=False hardcoded, OR run_susie_inf never exposes / propagates the est_tausq parameter; (B) a defensive threshold like `effective_tausq = tausq if tausq >= 1e-3 else 0.0` that zeros out the correctly-estimated tau^2 before applying it to the variance structure. Realistic gentropy-reference tau^2 estimates are in the 1e-5 to 1e-4 range on SuSiE-inf inputs, so any threshold above ~1e-4 nullifies activation across all geometries.
